description:
Photographs, floorplans, EPC graphs and brochures for a property, from the
    listings we have crawled. Narrow with `types` — a comma-separated list of
    `image`, `floorplan`, `epc`, `brochure`, `virtual_tour`.

    EVERY LINK IS OURS AND EVERY LINK EXPIRES. Do not store them; call this
    again when you need fresh ones, and set `ttl_seconds` to match how long the
    surface you are building keeps them on screen. The portal's own URL is
    never returned, so a saved response cannot turn into a hotlink later.

    COVERAGE IS UNEVEN AND THE COUNTS TELL YOU. We hold the actual files for
    floorplans and brochures only, and for a minority of those; everything else
    — including all photographs — is a link that redirects to the source.
    `n_held_by_us` against `n_redirected` says which is which for this property,
    and `delivery` says it per item. Do not describe a property as having no
    photographs when the answer is `no_media`: about a third of listings never
    resolve to a UPRN, so that is as often a matching gap as an absence.

    Each item carries the portal and host it came from — useful when a user
    asks where a picture is from, and when one source turns out to be bad.
    UK only. Free. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_media
title: Photographs, floorplans and brochures
